item.title: Roc360 REIT receives $150M investment to target renovation loans

item.description: According to the New York City Housing Partnership, the program is expected to support approximately 1,000 workers each year.

item.title: Toll Brothers announces Karl Mistry as new CEO, Doug Yearley to become Executive Chairman
item.description: Karl Mistry becomes CEO as Toll Brothers leans on high-income buyers and plans its complete exit from the multifamily business.

item.title: Unexpected retirement expenses can strain senior homeowners
item.description: Researchers found that unexpected costs are the norm, not the exception. In any given year, 83% of retired households experience at least one unexpected expense.

item.title: Trump directs GSEs to buy $200B in MBS to push mortgage rates lower
item.description: President Donald Trump said Thursday that he is directing representatives at the government-sponsored enterprises (GSEs) to purchase $200 billion in mortgage-backed securities (MBS), a move he said is intended to bring mortgage rates down.
